# Support and Assistance

This repository is maintained with **community support**.

## Official Google Support

For official support, SDK bugs, crashes, and account issues, use the
following channels:

* Submit bug reports, crash logs, and support inquiries via
  [Official Google Support](https://support.google.com/admob/gethelp).
* Review implementation tutorials in the
  [Google Mobile Ads Unity Quick Start Guide](https://developers.google.com/admob/unity/quick-start).
* Discuss implementation questions on the
  [Google Mobile Ads SDK Developer Forum](https://groups.google.com/g/google-admob-ads-sdk).

---

## GitHub Issues Policy

GitHub Issues are intended for:
1. **Community Help Requests**: Request assistance or discuss sample code with
   other developers.
2. **Feature Requests**: Propose enhancements or new capabilities for the Unity
   plugin wrapper.

Bugs, crashes, and official support requests should be submitted directly to
[Official Google Support](https://support.google.com/admob/gethelp) for
dedicated triage.
